name: diemp-government-investigation-platform
description: Government Digital Investigation and Document Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "cd server && npm.cmd run dev" "cd client && npm.cmd run dev"
scripts.build: cd server && npm.cmd run build && cd ../client && npm.cmd run build
scripts.install:all: npm.cmd install && cd server && npm.cmd install && cd ../client && npm.cmd install
scripts.build:prod: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push && npm run build && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && cd client && npm install && npm run build
